content: Backtrader development stalled around 2021, open issues/PRs unmerged - usable but unmaintained, no broker data feed for forex by default. VectorBT (Numba/Rust-accelerated, vectorized) excels at fast parameter sweeps and supports walk-forward splitting natively but is research-oriented (no live broker integration). Backtesting.py is simplest but lacks live trading support. None directly replace the project's already-built custom backtest_engine.py; vectorbt is most relevant if scaling parameter search beyond current random+mutation approach.
